segments.text: Google just picked India's Rupe over Visa and Mastercard. It launched a new credit card called Flex with Access Bank
and it runs on Rupe and UPI. Now look at the opportunity. India has 500 million UPI users but barely 50 million credit
card holders. That gap is the opportunity. Embedding credit directly into everyday payments. Here's why that matters. For decades, Global Credit ran
on Visa and Mastercard. They charge merchants 2 to 3% on every transaction.
A hidden tax that gets passed to you through higher prices and weaker rewards. India built an alternative.
Rupe and UPI. Zero merchant fees. Over 16 billion transactions every month. Do you think Rupe and UPI can challenge
Visa and Mastercard globally? Tell me in the comments and follow full disclosure.
